answer: Each jetty decays at the nadir, and an operator admits a new identity only by re-buying one such jetty; the re-purchase burns fresh onyx equal to the operator's prior total onyx burn plus one onyx. The nadir writes the burn before the next jetty is issued, so the kth identity burns \(2^{k-1}\) onyx and k clones burn \(2^k-1\) onyx.
